name: Neo Blue-Eyes Hyper Ultimate Dragon
desc:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + 2 monsters that are "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" and/or mention "Endless Darkness"
Can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Neo Blue-Eyes Hyper Ultimate Dragon" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Endless Darkness" from your Deck or GY. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can banish that monster.
